info.text:
Disney's parks out-earned its movies, TV and streaming two to one.

Fiscal 2025 operating income: Experiences (parks, cruises, merch) a record $10.0B; Entertainment (movies, TV, streaming) $4.7B.
Revenue: Entertainment $42.5B vs Experiences $36.2B. Margins: about 28% vs 11%.
Disney plans about $60B of parks and cruise investment over ~10 years (2023).

Sources: Disney FY2025 results and 10-K, Disney (Sept 2023).
